inv.desc_ca:
De particular a particular, es ven local comercial situat en xamfrà del carrer Lausana i María Moliner. Al voltant de 60 metres en planta carrer (recentment reformat de sostres, terra laminat de fusta i servei). Aire condicionat de fred i bomba de calor. 1 servei en planta carrer. Soterrani de 75 metres.
Preu 85.000 euros.
També s'ofereix en lloguer per una renda mensual de 500 euros/mes.
3 amplis aparadors en direcció al carrer Lausana, al mateix xamfrà i al carrer María Moliner.
Molt lluminós.
Molt a prop de l'Avinguda Tenor Fleta.
Sense cobrament de gestió ni comissions. Particular.
Pilar.

inv.desc_en:
For sale by owner, commercial premises located on the corner of Calle Lausana and María Moliner. Approximately 60 square meters on the ground floor (recently renovated ceilings, laminate wood flooring, and restroom). Cold air conditioning and heat pump. 1 restroom on the ground floor. 75-square-meter basement.
Price: 85,000 euros.
Also available for rent at a monthly rate of 500 euros/month.
3 large display windows facing Calle Lausana, the corner itself, and Calle María Moliner.
Very bright.
Very close to Avenida Tenor Fleta.
No management fees or commissions. Private seller.
Pilar.
